05. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Informant who is the father of the victim.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with (Spl) (POCSO) Case No.53 of 2024 pending in the Court of learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court (POCSO),
Angul arising out of Bagadia P.S. Case No.166 of 2024 for commission of the offence under Sections 376(2)(n)/376(3)/506 IPC read with Section 6(1) of the POSCO Act.

entities.text:
Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court (POCSO),
Angul
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 3. It is stated at the Bar that on attaining the marriageable age the victim has expressed her desire to join the Petitioner in matrimony.
4. Learned counsels for the State submits that such submission cannot be taken into account at this stage taking into account the allegations, inter alia, under the POSCO Act.

5. Considering rival submissions, to give a chance to reconciliation to take effect, it is directed that on surrendering within three weeks hence and moving for bail, the Petitioner shall be released on bail by the learned Court in seisin on such terms as deemed just and proper.

6. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
